en.headline: Man rescued after falling 30 metres on Fei Ngo Shan slope
en.dek: Rescuers found him conscious about two hours after a report near Jat's Incline before dawn and took him to United Christian Hospital.
body: A man was rescued from a slope on Fei Ngo Shan, also known as Kowloon Peak, after falling about 30 metres in the early hours of Thursday. Police received a report at about 3.49 a.m. that someone had slipped near Jat's Incline and was trapped on the hillside.
Search and rescue teams reached the scene and located the man at about 5.41 a.m. at a point roughly 30 metres down the slope. He was conscious when found.
He was taken to United Christian Hospital for treatment. Police said they were investigating how the fall happened.

zh.headline: 飛鵝山男子墮約30米山坡被困 清晨救起送院
zh.dek: 警方凌晨近4時接報扎山道一帶有人失足被困，救援人員約5時41分在山邊尋獲事主，清醒送聯合醫院。
body: 飛鵝山周四凌晨發生墮山意外。警方約凌晨3時49分接報，指扎山道一帶有人懷疑失足墮山坡被困。
救援人員到場搜索，至清晨約5時41分在山邊約30米深處尋獲一名男子，並將他救起。事主當時仍然清醒。
他被送往基督教聯合醫院治理。警方正調查意外起因。
